name: ClawChat
releaseNotes: Fixes excessive background CPU and battery use from the embedded Syncthing runtime. By default, sync runs while ClawChat is open, then stops after a short background grace period. The Sync screen now has an explicit Background sync toggle for always-on receive/notify behavior, background polling is throttled when enabled, and the sync notification includes a Stop sync action.
description: ClawChat is an Android-first private messenger for no-phone-number chat. It creates a local cryptographic identity, pairs devices with invites, syncs encrypted message events through embedded Syncthing, supports attachments and voice messages, delivered/read receipts, local notifications, and now keeps background Syncthing work opt-in to reduce battery use.
